exact_tokens: `Formatters_System.md` has unresolved ownership splits with LSP formatting, under-specified DAE behavior, custom formatter subprocess/FileSafe bypass risk, and unregistered `format.*` events.
notes: Formatters_System.md has four distinct issues: (1) LSP formatting ownership conflict, (2) under-specified DAE behavior for formatters, (3) custom formatter subprocess can bypass FileSafe/tool policy, (4) format.* events not registered in Contracts_V0.
